metric: All reported crashes with valid coordinates in the NYC map extent; smoothed counts per square km per day.
exclusion: Incomplete edge months excluded. Missing/out-of-extent coordinates omitted from map; monthly reported totals include them.
comparison: One fixed map extent and color scale across frames; power normalization gamma=0.5. No normalization by traffic exposure.

exports.heatmap_palette: High-contrast amber, burnt orange, and deep brick red.
High-contrast amber, burnt orange, and deep brick red.

count_definition: Citywide monthly reported crashes; people = NUMBER OF PERSONS INJURED + NUMBER OF PERSONS KILLED. Counts include reports without map coordinates; maps omit those reports.
map_definition: Separate fixed color scales across time: smoothed crashes or people injured/killed per km² per day, respectively. Colors are not comparable between the two GIFs.
